alignment_bytes.note: Payload sections of envelope binaries start on this boundary.

alpha_mode.note: Alpha is straight (not premultiplied): 0 transparent, maximum opaque.

angle_direction.note: A positive angle turns clockwise as seen on screen (with y down: from the +x axis towards the +y axis).

angle_file_unit_per_degree.note: The `hueOff` colour-transform operand and preset adjust angles are in 1/60000 degree.

angle_unit.note: Every angle is in degrees (preset adjust angles and hue offsets excepted: see angle_file_unit_per_degree).

color_component_max.note: Colour components r, g, b, a are integers 0..255.

color_space.note: Every colour value and every decoded picture is sRGB.

endianness.note: Every envelope binary is little-endian. MessagePack header integers inside an envelope are big-endian by MessagePack's own definition (spec/layouts/ENVELOPE.layout.txt section 4).

excerpt_sample_format.note: An audio excerpt is linear PCM, signed 16-bit little-endian, interleaved, WAVE format tag 1.

excerpt_seconds.note: An audio excerpt holds at most this many seconds from the start of the sound.

hash_algorithm.note: Every files[].sha256, every input_hash, license.sha256, and spec_sha256.

length_unit.note: Every coordinate, length, font size and line width is in points.

number_format.note: Every JSON number is the shortest decimal that parses back to the same IEEE 754 binary64 value.

outline_line_ending.note: Every line of the outline text ends with one U+000A.

paint_order.note: In every list of shapes the first element is at the bottom; each later one paints over it.

pixel_origin.note: Pixel row 0 of a PNG is the top row.

pointer_syntax.note: A `pointer` is an RFC 6901 JSON Pointer into the owner node's payload; array indices count from 0.

points_per_inch.note: One point is 1/72 inch: 72 points = 25.4 mm.

ratio_file_unit_per_whole.note: Colour-transform operands and preset adjust ratios are integers in 1/100000: 100000 = 100 % = 1.0.

signature_algorithm.note: SIGNATURE.json only. Refusing it is the 'unverified' state, not damage.

style_index_base.note: A theme style reference `index` counts format-scheme entries from 1; 0 means none.

text_encoding.note: Every text and JSON payload, INCLUDING MANIFEST.json - which is why the scope is container.

time_unit.note: Every duration, delay and media position is in milliseconds.

x_axis.note: x grows to the right; the slide's origin (0, 0) is its top-left corner.

y_axis.note: y grows downwards: a box's top edge is its smaller y.

note: The machine-readable convention to node-type map of profile presentation/1 (SPEC.md section 10.2, ruling S-17). The convention set is a property of the PROFILE, not of the reader (S-25): check these and no others.
